title: Logix Catalog ECP5 FPGAs
description: The ECP5 FPGAs of Logix Catalog (github.com/openlogix/logix-catalog): the schema of fpgas/ecp5.json, which maps each FPGA ID to its facts. The file's name gives the FPGAs' family.

propertyNames.description: "$schema", or an FPGA ID: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, such as ice40hx8k-ct256.

Fpga.description: One ECP5 FPGA: its part, its size and the names the toolchain uses for it.

part_number.description: The vendor's part number, such as ICE40HX4K-TQ144.

nextpnr_device.description: The device nextpnr-ecp5 uses (--25k and so on, without the dashes), such as 25k.

nextpnr_package.description: The package nextpnr-ecp5 uses (--package), such as CABGA256.

nextpnr_speed.description: The speed grade nextpnr-ecp5 uses (--speed), such as 6.

jtag_idcode.description: The FPGA's JTAG ID code as openFPGALoader's --detect reports it: 0x and 8 lowercase hex digits. It identifies the chip, so FPGAs made from the same chip share it. Optional: without it, tools can't check the connected FPGA before programming over JTAG.
